note: Extra indicators render in the 'leading indicators watch' and community modules. They NEVER enter the validated composite score automatically — promote one into pipeline.py's SIGNALS only after re-running backtest.py shows it improves out-of-sample performance.

indicators.label: Texas initial unemployment claims (monthly avg)
indicators.source: FRED TXICLAIMS weekly; refresh.py aggregates to monthly. Statewide, not El Paso-specific.
indicators.status: awaiting local refresh (weekly series too long for the cloud fetch channel)

indicators.label: Texas business applications (monthly)
indicators.source: FRED BUSAPPWNSATX weekly; refresh.py aggregates to monthly. Statewide.

indicators.label: El Paso building permits (monthly units)
indicators.source: Census Building Permits Survey, El Paso MSA — monthly file drop; not on FRED (county series BPPRIV048141 is annual).

indicators.label: El Paso city sales-tax allocation
indicators.source: Texas Comptroller monthly allocation for City of El Paso (comptroller.texas.gov, Allocation Historical Summary).

indicators.label: Border crossings: trucks, El Paso port only (excl. Ysleta since 2020)
indicators.source: BTS Border Crossing/Entry Data (data.bts.gov, keg4-3bc2), port_name='El Paso' (2402). The 2020-03 drop is the CBP split of Ysleta (2401) into its own port, not a reporting error — the dashboard's border panel and border_test.py use El Paso + Ysleta. Watch z here is El Paso port only.

indicators.label: Border crossings: personal vehicles, El Paso port only (excl. Ysleta since 2020)
indicators.source: BTS Border Crossing/Entry Data, port_name='El Paso' (2402) — excludes Ysleta from 2020-03 (port split); combined series used in the border panel.

indicators.label: Border crossings: pedestrians, El Paso port only (excl. Ysleta since 2020)
indicators.source: BTS Border Crossing/Entry Data, port_name='El Paso' (2402) — excludes Ysleta from 2020-03 (port split). Single-month spikes in the source (e.g. 2025-11) are kept as published.

indicators.label: Dallas Fed El Paso Business-Cycle Index (benchmark)
indicators.source: dallasfed.org/research/econdata/coini/elpcoini — monthly xlsx; benchmark/target-definer only, NEVER a score input. Used by benchmarks.py when present.
indicators.status: awaiting local refresh (binary xlsx not fetchable from the cloud sandbox; refresh.py downloads it locally)

indicators.label: Mexico manufacturing production, YoY
indicators.source: FRED MEXPRMNTO01IXOBM (OECD MEI) — discontinued Mar 2024; successor: INEGI IMMEX Chihuahua manufacturing employment (refresh.py fetches locally).

indicators.label: Food-assistance demand (households served)
indicators.source: Partner data — e.g. El Pasoans Fighting Hunger, anonymized monthly households served or pantry visits.
